reason: I already track calories in my own app and my mother runs our kitchen, so a receipt-scanning app is not going to change how we shop. I'd maybe download the free version out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay for Plus.
objection: My mother or the helper does the shopping and cooking, not me with an app. Scanning every receipt feels like extra work, and I doubt it reads Arabic receipts or local market purchases that have no receipt at all.
would_change_my_mind: If nutrition and calorie tracking worked well on its own with Arabic dishes, was free or cheap, and the household could add the groceries without scanning receipts.
